title: Unit Event — MORE MORE Making Christmas — Episode4 Idol / Manager?

meta.Event Outline: Following the success of the elementary school event, the girls start planning for another show in real life, but encounter various obstacles along the way. Just when things seem difficult, they receive an email from a fan offering to help. Minori is thrilled, but...

rows.Line: Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (How can we make it so this event's fun for all of our fans...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'd hate to do this to Hayakawa, but finding a smaller venue may be the way to go. Then, we could run things on our own and require less staff...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But the smaller venues are all booked up right now, so at worst, we may have to wait over half a year until things start slowing down for them.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If that happens, our fans would be so disappointed... That's something I'd like to avoid no matter what.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Should I talk to Airi about increasing our budget? Or...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I don't know what the right answer is...
How will our fans be able to enjoy themselves...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This proposal looks professional...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That fan of ours, Saito... Their proposal looked so professional and well put together...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And our fans would probably have the most fun if we perform at the venue Hayakawa found for us.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But that person's also one of our fans. They must be looking forward to seeing us put on an event just as much as anyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, let's take a step back and try to look at things from a different perspective...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I need to think more flexibly, like when Airi and the others decided to move forward as freelancers...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's right. Airi went to talk things over with Rin that time...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Maybe I'll find an answer if I go over to see them.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? The stage? But I'm off to the side... Where are Miku and the others...?
song00002_off_f

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, is a show about to start? And the lights...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hi, everyone! How's it going♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We'll all be doing a show together today, and we promise to make it an unforgettable one!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, let's jump right in with our first song! Start the music!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A show with all of them...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(This is incredible...
All the lighting and effects match their formation perfectly.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Not only that, it feels like they put a lot more effort into this performance compared to normal...)
Perfect! Adding in more yellow for the lighting was definitely the right choice!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: K-KAITO...?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, hello there!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You must be Haruka.
Miku and Len have told me all about you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: My name is KAITO. It's nice to finally meet you. I arrived here not too long ago to help Miku and the others with their shows.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Help with their shows...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Does that mean you put all this together, KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, not all of it. I'm helping with the effects right now, but I did get a chance to work on the proposal for this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You sound more like a producer than an idol... Am I right in saying that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Close but not quite!
I'm an idol, manager and...
Well, many other things.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I enjoy being on stage and working behind the scenes, so I thought, “Why not do both?”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
Still, that seems like a lot of work...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did you see the way Rin and Len turned just now?! Absolute perfection!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank goodness too... Those two have been working so hard on how they turn...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (KAITO's eyes are sparkling like he's watching his own children perform on stage.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I guess it means that he genuinely enjoys supporting those around him and helping them succeed.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'd do anything to have staff like him around for our event. It'd make everything so much easier...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <And please feel free to disregard this email if you are not having any trouble with your event.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <However, if you are in a position of requiring outside help, I would be more than happy to be of assistance. I solemnly swear to do my absolute best!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is something on your mind, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? How did you...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Chock it up to being a manager. I can tell at a glance what idols are feeling! Well, a little at least...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Thank you for asking.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've been thinking about putting on our own event but are a bit stuck right now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Having your fans see what goes on behind the scenes... That is a tricky one.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, Haruka, I think I understand why you feel so hesitant.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The stage is a wonderful place that shines, sparkles and makes everyone in the audience smile...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But that light doesn't reach the other side of the stage. It's a place that can be cruel at times.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And you being aware of that fact is why you feel the way you do about exposing your fans to the other side, yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I also understand how Minori feels about this. We can't put on an event all on our own, and us not being able to hold one means we'd be disappointing our fans...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we all want to spread and inspire hope in our fans as idols...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If we have some of them see what goes on behind the scenes and they're no longer able to enjoy themselves as fans, I'd...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This is just my opinion...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe that idols are able to spread hope to not just the fans in the audience, but those working behind the scenes on the other side as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even all the staff...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! They put their hearts and souls into setting everything up from the lights to the sound from scratch. They want their beloved idols to dazzle as much as possible.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Isn't that a wonderful thing?
I personally feel a great sense of accomplishment whenever I succeed at doing that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You feel that too...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. I have a feeling that these fans of yours suggested this because they want to experience what happens on the other side firsthand.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It'll be a special experience for them since they'll get to see their favorite idols smile by making their event a success.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There's probably no better feeling in the world than when that happens.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They'll get to feel it too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Do our fans really want to help build our event from the ground up and make it a success...? If so, I couldn't be happier...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But even if that's the case...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Is it okay for us to lean on them this much...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I suspect you need more time to find your answer...
song00002_off_sabi

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it's okay to worry and think about it for as long as you like. Ultimately, I think it just comes down to believing in your decision.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I'm sure you'll find a good answer, Haruka. I'm sure things will be just fine.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you very much, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What a great show.
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Good morning.
Let's do our best during practice today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Morning, Haruka!
That just leaves Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, did you not get enough sleep last night...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That obvious, huh...?
I had a lot on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
About staffing, right?
I tried asking around a little more, but didn't really have any luck.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: My friends from junior high said that they're all busy around this time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I tried asking Shii as well, but she already has plans to throw a party with her friends that day...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: G-Good morning!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori, good morning...
It's not like you to be the last one here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-There's something I'd like to discuss with all of you... I was trying to figure out how to say this last night and wound up oversleeping as a result...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, but why so formal all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What is it that you'd like to discuss?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-It's...!
Um... So...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Can we have our fans help us put on our event? I really think we should!
